# ERA ontology and SHACL shapes

`tests/fixtures/era-shacl.nt.gz` is an unmodified copy (as N-Triples) of the
RINF SHACL shapes of the European Union Agency for Railways (ERA), version
3.3.4. At run time the worker mirrors these shapes from ERA's repository, or
downloads them from ERA's ontology repository at a pinned tag
(`quality.shapes_tag`).

- Source: https://gitlab.com/era-europa-eu/public/interoperable-data-programme/era-ontology/era-ontology
  (`era-shacl/ERA-RINF-shapes.ttl`) and the graph
  `http://data.europa.eu/949/graph/rinf/shacl` at https://data-interop.era.europa.eu/
- © European Union Agency for Railways (creator and publisher)
- Licence: European Union Public Licence v1.2 (EUPL-1.2), declared by the
  repository and by the shapes themselves
  (`dct:license <http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec_impl/2017/863/oj>`). `LICENSE`
  here is the repository's licence file at tag `v3.3.4`, copied unmodified.
